deadline.value: Submit the application by midnight CST on December 1, 2026 (the page labels this 'Fall 2026', but the date is the current cycle's); supporting documents may arrive later without a guarantee of full consideration.
deadline.quote: applications must be submitted by midnight CST on December 1, 2026.

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required.
gre_general.quote: Applications to the Ph.D. program in Chemical Engineering no longer requires the submission of GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

fee_waiver.value: International applicants cannot get a fee waiver and the department offers none.
fee_waiver.quote: International students are not eligible for application fee waivers. The McKetta Department of Chemical Engineering does not provide application fee waivers.

supervisor.value: No need to contact faculty before applying; supervisors are chosen after students start in the fall.
supervisor.quote: Applicants do not need to contact a faculty member before applying for fall admission. Research supervisors are not selected until after students start in the fall.

funding.value: All admitted doctoral students get full support (stipend, tuition, fees and health insurance) as TAs, GRAs or fellows for the duration of the degree.
funding.quote: All admitted doctoral students in chemical engineering are given full financial support as teaching assistants, graduate research assistants, and/or through one of many university fellowships.

entry_route.value: PhD only; most students start without a master's. A chemical engineering bachelor's typically qualifies; other science/engineering graduates need suitable preparation.
entry_route.quote: Most students commence the program without first obtaining a master’s degree.

notes: PhD only, no terminal master's. Selected applicants may get a Zoom interview; decisions typically by early January.
